Executive Summary — Rajasthan Royals IPL 2027 Auction Strategy
Official Submission

This submission presents an independently engineered, empirical sports analytics pipeline built from the raw ball-by-ball delivery datasets (2022–2026). To solve the IPL auction challenge, we enforce a strict IPL-First Eligibility Gate: every primary candidate must have played at least 10 IPL matches, faced/bowled at least 200/180 total balls, and faced/bowled at least 100 balls under high-pressure conditions in the IPL. Zero-IPL players are strictly quarantined into international scouting prospects.

Top Batter Under Pressure

#1 Suryakumar Yadav (Rating: 74.80) — 100% Bootstrap Top-10 probability. Boasts an extraordinary 175.7 IPL HP strike rate, 47.1 average, and +9.3 Delta SR elevation under extreme match pressure.

Top Bowler Under Pressure

#1 Jasprit Bumrah (Rating: 79.68) — 100% Bootstrap Top-10 probability. Conceding an unmatched 7.42 RPO in IPL high pressure across 349 balls with 29 wickets and 42.9% dot balls.

Pre-Delivery Mathematical Pressure Formulation
Strictly Pre-Delivery

Pressure is formulated exclusively using information available prior to the release of the delivery to prevent future-information leakage:

Innings 2 (Chasing):
PI = 0.40 × (RRR / 9.0) + 0.35 × ((10 - WicketsInHand) / 8.0) + 0.25 × (BallsRemaining / 120.0)

Innings 1 (Setting):
PI = Baseline (0.15) + Collapse Crisis Boost (Wickets Lost ≥ 3 in Overs 0-6: +0.40) + Death Acceleration (Overs 16-20: +0.45)

Context Adjustments:
• Knockout / Playoff Multiplier: × 1.15
• Super Over: Fixed PI = 1.00 (Maximum Closeness)
• High-Pressure Delivery Threshold: PI ≥ 0.55 (Captures exactly 54,651 balls, 27.2% of dataset)

Detailed Metric Explanations:
• Scoring Rate (RPO): Total runs conceded/scored per 6 legal balls. Demonstrates IPL pressure requires 9.52 RPO par vs 8.57 RPO in internationals.
• Bat Runs / Ball: Average runs scored off the bat per delivery, reflecting boundary impact and rotation efficiency.
• Dismissal Rate: Wickets per legal delivery. Under pressure, IPL wickets fall every 13.6 balls, penalizing rash strokeplay.
• Dot Ball %: Proportion of balls yielding zero runs. IPL pressure forces aggressive strike rotation (only 30.7% dots).
• Boundary %: Fours and sixes frequency. Surges to 21.0% in IPL pressure (+3.4% over T20Is), proving IPL finishes demand elite boundary clearing.
